name: Bellavista
headline: The Art of Time
intro: Founded in 1977 in Erbusco, nestled in the rolling hills of Franciacorta, Bellavista was born from Vittorio Moretti's passion for a singular hillside overlooking Lake Iseo. Over the decades, the estate has grown into one of the most distinguished emblems of fine Italian winemaking on the international stage. Every bottle embodies the uncompromised craftsmanship of Made in Italy: more than one hundred hillside parcels harvested entirely by hand, gentle pressing using traditional wooden basket presses, and extended aging deep inside cellars carved into the morainic rock. Here, absolute respect for the terroir, bespoke attention to detail, and the patience of time preserve a mastery passed down harvest after harvest.

name: Domori
headline: Redefining Haute Chocolaterie
intro: Founded in 1997 in None, near Turin, Domori was born from Gianluca Franzoni's vision to safeguard the world's rarest aromatic cacao varieties and revive ancient Criollo genetics. Over nearly three decades, the maison has established itself as an uncompromising pioneer in haute chocolaterie, championing biodiversity and direct partnerships with local growers. Every creation embodies authentic Made in Italy craftsmanship: minimal, respectful processing using only fine cocoa and cane sugar, free from added cocoa butter, artificial flavors, or lecithin. Through gentle conching and low-temperature roasting, Domori safeguards the beans' natural aromatic richness, elevating fine chocolate into pure culinary art.

name: E. Marinella
headline: The Knot of Elegance
intro: Founded in 1914 by Eugenio Marinella along the Riviera di Chiaia in Naples, the maison was born with the ambition of creating an authentic corner of British style combined with the warmth and flair of Neapolitan elegance. Over the course of more than a century, guided from generation to generation up to Maurizio and Alessandro Marinella, the boutique has become a global landmark for haute couture and bespoke tie-making, dressing heads of state, royalty, and international leaders. Every creation embodies the uncompromised craftsmanship of Made in Italy: exclusive English silks still hand-printed using traditional methods, cut and sewn one by one by master tailors in the Neapolitan workshop.
